weeks.focus: SQL basics: SELECT, WHERE, GROUP BY, JOIN
resources: Mode SQL Tutorial for Data Analysis

project.title: Retail Sales SQL Report
project.brief: Using a sample retail sales database (orders, customers, products), write SQL queries that answer: top 5 products by revenue, monthly sales trend, and the city with the most repeat customers. Submit your queries and a short explanation of each result.
criteria: Queries run correctly and return the right answers
Uses GROUP BY and JOIN appropriately
Results are explained in plain business language

weeks.focus: Cleaning and exploring data with Python Pandas
resources: Pandas official 10 minutes to pandas guide

project.title: Clean a Messy Expenses Dataset
project.brief: Take a messy company expenses CSV (missing values, duplicate rows, inconsistent category names, dates in mixed formats) and clean it using Pandas. Then report total spend by category and month.
criteria: Handles missing values and duplicates sensibly
Final summary numbers are correct and clearly presented

weeks.focus: Data visualization and dashboards in Power BI
resources: Microsoft Learn: Get started with Power BI
Storytelling with Data (book, Cole Nussbaumer Knaflic)
Guy in a Cube YouTube channel

project.title: Sales Performance Dashboard
project.brief: Build a one-page Power BI (or Tableau) dashboard for a sales manager showing revenue trend, top regions, top products and a KPI card for month-over-month growth. Write 3 insights the manager should act on.
criteria: Dashboard is clean and easy to read in 10 seconds

weeks.focus: Statistics for analysts + end-to-end case study
resources: Google Data Analytics Certificate – case study module

project.title: Capstone: Why Did Profits Drop?
project.brief: A small company's profit fell 15% last quarter. Using the provided sales and cost data, find the likely causes using SQL, Pandas and charts, and present your findings as a 5-slide summary with recommendations.
criteria: Uses data to support each claim
Applies basic statistics correctly (averages, % change, comparisons)
